For this course, the modern world of computing is defined as one based on mobile devices (e.g., smartphones, netbooks, tablets, and similar) as the fundamental computing units that rely on cloud storage (e.g., Google Apps, Flickr/Picasa, Facebook, file backup systems such as Carbonite, and similar).
